predeclared_expectation: Canonical CTCF motif is enriched near final narrow-peak summits
measurement: Motif enrichment and centrality using JASPAR MA0139.1
interpretation: Required biological plausibility; absence is a warning or failure according to the frozen criteria

predeclared_expectation: Biological replicates have positive signal and peak-rank concordance
measurement: FRiP, peak overlap, rank correlation and IDR
interpretation: Discordance is reported; it is not repaired by threshold tuning

predeclared_expectation: Final calls remain localized relative to external ENCODE peaks
measurement: Reciprocal overlap and summit distance against ENCFF519CXF
interpretation: Descriptive comparison only; ENCODE peaks are not ground truth

predeclared_expectation: CTCF signal is detectable at documented K562 beta-globin regulatory boundaries
measurement: Track inspection at the beta-globin locus
interpretation: Qualitative positive control, not a release gate by itself
